title: dot-prop get ignores the default value when the last path segment is missing
description: `dotProp.get(object, path, defaultValue)` must return `defaultValue` when every segment of the path exists except the last one: `dotProp.get({foo: {}}, 'foo.fake', 'some value')` should return `'some value'`, as it already does when an earlier segment is missing.
acceptance_criteria: a path whose value exists still returns that value
notes: SWE-bench-style. base_ref is the upstream fix's parent; hidden/test.js is the upstream test file at fix_commit. The scratch repo must hold base_ref's history only (bench/factory/README.md, 'Scratch repositories').
